title: Staged Knowledge Topic Catalog
body_html:
Staged Knowledge Topic Catalog

This catalog records the immediate staged topic folders. The frontmatter is a compatibility header for mdblueprint versions before exact topics.md files are reserved.

Topics

  • approachability - approachability theorem statements and proof routes.
  • auction - auction-specific mechanism specializations.
  • extensive_game - extensive-form game concepts and finite-tree infrastructure.
  • fixed_point - fixed-point theorem targets and reductions.
  • lattice - lattice support facts.
  • linear_algebra - linear algebra support facts.
  • linear_programming - LP duality and complementarity support.
  • mechanism_design - mechanism-design primitives and theorem interfaces.
  • order - order support facts.
  • strategic_games - normal-form game concepts and theorem targets.
  • utility - preferences, lotteries, and expected-utility material.
  • zero_sum - zero-sum games, minimax, and value theory.

Boundary

Place a new staged node in the folder for its main mathematical ownership. Use tags or additional topic membership for cross-cutting concepts rather than duplicating node files.
